acceptance: All six sealed manifests match fixed axes and native verify passes; all six demonstrate native invocation. Preserve typed stop and replay cursor. Capped native calls demonstrate invocation only, never completed solve. Pre-entry or construction censoring means six-cell coverage acceptance failed; retain outputs without retry.
stopping: Fail fast on command/assertion error; preserve complete and partial output, zero retries. Parent timeout 1800s mandatory.
publication: Parent archives full output including failed fixtures, runner/checker/protocol/control receipts/source/binary binding to authorized S3 namespace with conditional PUT, HEAD, GET and SHA256 verification. Restored native verify required for every sealed shard; no verification-success claim for unsealed partials. No cloud calls in runner.
scope: Finite m2 software increment only. Original m2..15 corpus goal retained; no scientific samples, performance claim, full derivation/instruction trace claim, or scalar recovery claim.
